# Per-repo CLAUDE.md template

Fill from the project answers plus the profile. Omit any line or section whose value is empty.

```markdown
# <name>

<description>

## Context

**Stack:** <techStack, comma-separated>
**Goal:** <goals>
**How I use Claude here:** <claudeUse>

## Constraints

<constraints>

## Voice

<name of person>'s preferences: <deliveryStyle> delivery, <tone> tone.

**Never:**
- <neverDo[i]>

---

*Generated by [agentille](https://github.com/hasuwini77/agentille) — edit freely.*
```

End the file with a single newline; no trailing whitespace.
